name: Age of Trailblaze! Formalwear Set
desc: An outfit for the conductor. They can change into it using Pom-Pom's Coatroom in the Party Car.
lore: A vintage formal outfit Pom-Pom wears for role-playing sessions. Despite Pom-Pom's best efforts to add some gravitas with a fake beard, not a single passenger recognized the tribute to a certain Nameless: the conductor is just too adorable!
